newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Financeer Soros proposes Warsaw study centre.
newsitem.headline: Financeer Soros proposes Warsaw study centre.

text.p: Hungarian-born financier George Soros proposed on Thursday that the European Union help him set up a post-graduate centre in Warsaw for about 1,000 students to enable them to study the integration of former commmunist Europe.
Commission officials said Soros presented his ideas during a meeting with the EU's External Affairs Commissioner Hans van den Broek who agreed to study the idea.
"Soros was interested in some form of co-financing," a spokesman said.
The centre, similar to one already created in Budapest, would cost an estimated $50 million to set up and then around $15 million a year to run.
